name: Diamond Template
comment: ERB-style embedding, matching packages/div's own tag grammar (see packages/div/lib/div/compiler.di's own header comment): everything outside <% %> is HTML, highlighted via VS Code's own built-in text.html.basic grammar (not bundled here -- referenced the same way EJS/ERB/Handlebars grammars already reference it); everything inside a tag is Diamond source, highlighted via source.diamond (editors/vscode/syntaxes/diamond.tmLanguage.json), the exact same grammar a .di file gets. A <%# ... %> comment/locals directive is its own, third case -- never HTML, never Diamond, just a comment.
